error[L0301]: this generic key needs an error set in a circular deduction dependency

  |
8 |         try relay(error)
  |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/r490-generic-error-key-cycle-reordered/program.ldn:11:1

11 | relay: (t: type, error: t) -> none ! ... = fail error end relay
   | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the generic routine awaiting deduction
  = note: D215: deduction needs a complete recovered atom set; a circular key/effect dependency cannot supply one
